events.title: Festive Night at NUMU
events.address: NUMU (New Museum Los Gatos), 106 E Main St, Los Gatos, CA 95030
events.description: The museum stays open late as a featured stop on the Los Gatos Chamber's Holiday Trolley route, with light refreshments, holiday crafts, music, and local art and history. Admission is $5 through Dec 10 and $10 day-of; always free for NUMU members, Los Gatos residents, and youth under 18.
events.blurb: Tour the museum after hours as a stop on the Los Gatos Holiday Trolley route, with holiday crafts, music, light refreshments, and local art and history.

events.title: Poetry Live! with Franny Choi and Cameron Awkward-Rich
events.address: The Studio, Stanford Live, 327 Lasuen St, Stanford, CA 94305
events.description: The 5th annual Poetry Live! spoken word event features poets Franny Choi and Cameron Awkward-Rich, accompanied by Stanford's Spoken Word Collective.
events.blurb: Hear spoken word from poets Franny Choi and Cameron Awkward-Rich, joined by Stanford's Spoken Word Collective, at the fifth annual Poetry Live!
